_release_stage_comment: draft or final. The judge review is bound to the SHA-256 of the compiled PDF, so every rebuild voids it. draft: a missing, stale or unapproved review only warns and v2 gives no contest-ready verdict. final: all of it is enforced. Switch to final once, for the submission build.
_submission_comment: Submission integrity (submission_checker). team_control_number: the number COMAP assigned; the Summary Sheet and every page header must carry it (the template's 1111111 fails at final). anonymity_terms: student, advisor and school names; none may appear in the PDF or its properties. submission_pdf: the file you upload, named <control number>.pdf, under max_pdf_mb (COMAP: 25 MB).
_paper_hygiene_comment: Paper hygiene (paper_hygiene_checker); lines from reports/award_corpus_measurements.md (147 O papers). Notes to teammates and tool traces fail (0/147). Warn: defensive disclaimers (at least hedge_min_count hits and more than hedge_warn_per_10k per 10k words; 0/147 O papers), title longer than title_max_words or with a dash, fewer than 3 numbers on the Summary Sheet, median words per body page above max_words_per_page (O max 484), landscape pages.
_diagram_user_comment: A flowchart a teammate drew (PPTX/PDF/SVG): import it with import_flowchart.py and register {"figure_id": "fig:workflow", "origin": "user", "source": "flowchart.pptx", "pdf": "figures/concept/workflow.pdf"}. The gates then check the import receipt instead of the Kit's JSON: the source changed after import fails; text under 7 pt, too tall, too wide or raster images warn.
